additional_info.subject: RE: 0464643 - ID0464643-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R4 313059181006] Outlet-5 (DC-4) is out of service CRM:00472000466
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
Charger is again with faulted Outlet 4 and 5.
I look prior months to see if outlet 4 and 5 were working before.
This is from May, the same problem. My conclusion is that the commissioning from dispenser was not properly done and DC connections from DC3 and DC4 are swapped in the dispenser.
It's necessary to book a intervention to inspect and fix the problem. Take a spare fan to replace in case the fan from dispenser is faulty as well.
I'm moving this ticket to your queue.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso

additional_info.subject: RE: 0464643 - ID0464643-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R4 313059181006] Outlet-5 (DC-4) is out of service CRM:00472000466
additional_info.body:
Hi Joao,
Thanks for the detailed analysis and for checking the historical data.
We will plan an on-site intervention to inspect the dispenser commissioning and verify the DC3 / DC4 connections.
For the visit, we will go prepared and bring a spare converter and a spare dispenser's fan, so we can replace the components on-site if required and fix the issue in one intervention.
We will update you once the site visit is scheduled.
